title: Toasted Marshmallow Brownies
changes_from_base: Large-tray cocoa brownie topped with toasted gelatine-free mini marshmallows.
summary: A large tray of cocoa brownies finished with toasted gelatine-free mini marshmallows.
equipment: 23 x 33 cm metal baking tin, lined with baking paper
heatproof bowl and small pan (or a microwave)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line the large tin, leaving paper overhanging.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.text: Pour the boiling water over the chopped chocolate and cocoa and whisk until smooth.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Whisk in the sugar, oil, eggs, yolks, melted butter and vanilla, then fold in the flour and salt until just combined.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour into the lined tin, level it and bake for 28-32 min; a cocktail stick should come out with a few damp crumbs.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Scatter the marshmallows over the hot brownie and return to the oven for 3-4 min, until puffed and lightly golden. Watch closely, as they catch quickly.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely, then cut into 24 with an oiled knife.

tips: Check the marshmallow label to make sure they are gelatine-free.
Watch the marshmallows closely; they brown within a minute or two.
An oiled knife cuts through the marshmallow cleanly.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 3 days.
